arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/leads-legacy-audit.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git -c credential.helper= clone -q --depth 140 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
echo SOURCE_READONLY_SHA $(git rev-parse HEAD)
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import re,subprocess
def run(*a):
 p=subprocess.run(a,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=50)
 return p.stdout
log=run('git','log','--format=%H','--','main.py').splitlines()
print('REVISIONS_CHECKED',len(log))
keywords=('InviteToChannelRequest','GetParticipantsRequest','ChannelParticipants','UserPrivacyRestricted','UserNotMutualContact','UserChannelsTooMuch','PeerFlood','FloodWait','username','bot','admin','creator','participant','blacklist','whitelist','eligible')
chosen=None
for sha in reversed(log):
 try: src=run('git','show',sha+':main.py')
 except subprocess.CalledProcessError:continue
 if 'InviteToChannelRequest' in src and len(src.splitlines())>500:
  chosen=(sha,src)
  break
if chosen is None:
 print('LEGACY_ENGINE_NOT_FOUND_IN_DEPTH')
else:
 sha,src=chosen
 lines=src.splitlines()
 print('LEGACY_ENGINE_COMMIT',sha)
 print('LEGACY_LINES',len(lines))
 print('FUNCTIONS_RELEVANT')
 funs=[]
 for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
  if re.match(r'^\s*(?:async )?def ',line) and re.search(r'group|member|user|filter|invite|add|scrape|participant|eligible|privacy|permission|queue',line,re.I):
   funs.append((i,line.strip()[:100]))
 print(funs[:75])
 print('KEY_LOGIC_NAMES_AND_CONDITIONS')
 count=0
 for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
  s=line.strip()
  if any(w.casefold() in s.casefold() for w in keywords):
   if any(marker in s for marker in ('=', 'if ', 'except ', 'from ', 'import ', 'def ', 'continue','raise ')):
    print(f'{i}: {s[:180]}')
    count+=1
    if count>=115:break
 print('KEYWORD_PRESENT',[(k,k in src) for k in keywords])
PY
echo INSPECTION_ONLY_COMPLETE
